title: Great fun would recommend
text:
Great fun - Eva was brilliant, we learnt some basic steps and clapping in time. Small class of just 4, the hour flew by.
Would highly recommend. Hard to find but we met Eva in the main square.
author: lancaster2017

title: Flamenco school
text:
Excellent experience! Eva was very good. We took the lesson with the whole family, me, my husband, and my 10 and 7-year-old daughters. She was kind and patient with us. The girls had a lot of fun and appreciated it!
Highly recommended!

title: A wonderful experience!
text: What fun!! Eva made me feel comfortable right from the pick-up point and was warm, friendly, and professional! She gave me a new appreciation for the art of flamenco dance and is a wonderful teacher. I greatly enjoyed my time with her and would highly recommend her class. I will definitely come back if I have the opportunity to return to Sevilla!
